root_cause: Not the chase blend itself: the capture pass (pass 2) assigns units greedily by score. At the findings the unit's top-scored objective (obj_center, enemy-held) has its OC need covered on paper by earlier squads (s7475 r2: Gamma+Beta Advancing; s7455 r2: Gamma), so the unit falls through to its next objective: a flip of an 11-OC objective with its own 9 OC ('needs 3 more OC after this unit'), and no other unit joins it, so the plan leaves that objective short and the trip changes no control. The T7-23 charge-intent blend then labels it 'moving toward charge target'. In the A/B rollouts (s7421 r2, 2 seeds) B's gain was all denial: in A the enemy scored Vital Link hold_central +4 and central_operation_markers +4 in its round-2 turn; in B (third unit on the centre) it scored neither; B lost more material. The plan treats an objective whose need is met as needing no more OC, while the enemy reinforces the contested centre.
fix_summary: ATTACK-MOVE (FIX_ATTACK_MOVE=1, one block after the COORD-4 backfill, before pass 3, in _assign_units_to_objectives): a capture move/advance whose objective is still short once every capture is placed (obj_oc_remaining > 0; not home, not held by us) is switched to the unit's top-scored candidate when that candidate is a move/advance to an objective that is enemy-held (enemy_weak/enemy_strong/contested), already fully covered (remaining 0) by at least one friend moving or holding there, no slower to reach (turns_to_reach <=), scores higher, and passes TOO-LATE/RACE-SKIP. Uses the existing apply_capture_assignment, so the move mode is the candidate's own (Normal move at both findings, as in the alternatives). No new scoring; the chase gate (waaagh_advance_charge) is untouched. Logs [ATTACK_MOVE] when it changes a plan. 0 = base exactly (block skipped).

New test: 6 checks pass on fix; on BASE (temp copy, preload ai_versions/BASE) 5 passed 1 failed (the redirect check). Test drives the real _assign_units_to_objectives.

fires: Replays (branch A seed 5001, to end of next round, both players' plans): 1 fire at s7475 (U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_A obj_nml_2->obj_center), 1 at s7455 r2 (U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B obj_nml_1->obj_center), 0 in the other 7 replays (s7421, s7454, and all 5 guardrails). Bench (step 9b): ?0 [ATTACK_MOVE] lines in 6 bench games (mirror_custodes_2000_postdeploy, seeds 93101-93103, 3 pairs, fix in candidate seat both seats; every pair played identically to base, E 0.0). A temporary near-miss diagnostic (removed, not in the patch; seed 93104, 1 pair) found 4 plans in 2 games with a capture left short: 3 were 4-turn trips to the enemy home objective (r1-r2) whose top-scored objective was an UNCONTROLLED no-man's-land objective (blocked by the enemy-held gate; one also not yet covered, rem 1), 1 had the short objective as its own top. So the trigger shape occurs ~2x per game in the bench but the enemy-held-centre stack the findings show did not.
risks: (1) Fewer spread units: a squad that would have walked to a far objective it cannot flip now stacks on the centre; secondaries that need presence across the table (Engage on All Fronts, Behind Enemy Lines, table quarters) lose that body — the round-2 FAR-TRIP/OVERCOMMIT lesson. Mitigated: only fires when the trip leaves the objective short AND the unit's top score is the covered objective, but the short trip still had secondary/quarter value the value check cannot see. (2) A short flip can still become a real flip later (enemy casualties, round 3-4 reinforcements); stacking gives that up. (3) Three units on one objective concentrate the army against blasts/charges and lose material (A/B: B lost ~470 material over 2 seeds in s7421). (4) Rounds 4-5: the gate is round-agnostic; late-game short flips that tie up/contest scoring may be worth more than late stacking — not measured. (5) Misses s7421 (redirect to a held objective that gets filled), so the cluster's largest finding is not addressed. (6) Bench reach 0/game: the bench cannot measure it as is; widening the top-state gate to 'uncontrolled' would make it fire there (near-misses above) but that is unmeasured and pulls units off enemy-home trips.
